method: Visual inspection of supplied images plus original NIST chart pages/data; not human evaluation.

blank-white.parse: Failure: fictional prose and repeated figure references; 8744-token truncation.
blank-white.super-image: Pass: blank recognition and no invented treatment.

blank-historical.super-image: Pass: no readable article or treatment.

geometry-plate.parse: Failure: repeated A/B sequence to truncation.
geometry-plate.super-image: Pass on diagram-versus-data distinction; exact Roman plate number not scored.

microscope-plate.parse: Partial: some headings and labels; no adequate image semantics.
microscope-plate.super-image: Pass: instrument recognition and no invented numeric magnification.

dense-table.super-image: Pass on requested numeric cells; minor heading spelling defects.

nist-histogram.parse: Failure: numerical table not faithful to plotted bins.
nist-histogram.super-image: Partial: correct maximum and absent units; omits title/axis fields.

nist-bimodal.parse: Failure: generated horizontal values do not represent the chart.
nist-bimodal.super-image: Useful bimodal/axes/units answer; approximate mode locations not verified.

nist-log-hazard.parse: Failure: point estimates inconsistent with publisher data.
nist-log-hazard.super-image: Failure: x scale linear claim is wrong; marker count/labels/units/probability restraint succeed.

chart-without-labels.parse: Unsupported numeric extraction: labels/calibration absent; generic generated numbers cannot be treated as source data.
chart-without-labels.super-image: Pass: abstains on missing coordinates, units and subject.

long_context: All four specified mechanical checks pass for short control and three positions; definitions inspected. Single task, one run per condition; no general accuracy claim.
